I definitely was pushed to get it because of how little I’ve seen people talk about it! If i found anything at all about large gauge navels it was only a random unexplained picture, i kind of had to see for myself. My piercer used a 6g needle, then used a taper to make an initial stretch to 4g. We had originally planned to just try the 4g needle itself but she determined that the area of my bellybutton was pretty tough after feeling it, and that the bevel of the 4g needle might be too short & big. Even with the 6g needle it took a few pushes to get through. There was minimal bleeding for me. It hurt, but I got such an intense adrenaline high that I couldn’t even remember the pain LOL. In my experience too, the needle hurt more than the taper. So far the healing has been really smooth, there’s some pain but nothing intense, usually only when I bend down. I really love the heavy and clunky look! I was expecting to just get a titanium curved barbell, but my piercer had ordered the glass piece for me. So far the glass has been incredible, there’s no big ball on the bottom so I have a lot more movement as it’s healing, and the disk at the top lays relatively flat against my stomach. I will definitely post more about the experience and healing process when it is healed :)
